title: Protocol to establish an oviduct epithelial cell line derived from Gallus gallus using Percoll for in vitro validation of recombinant proteins
protocol: Euthanize chicken by injection of sodium pentobarbitone into the medial metatarsal vein or brachial wing vein.
Weigh hen to determine the amount of sodium pentobarbitone required (200 mg/kg).
Pluck abdomen feathers.
Spray F10 disinfectant or 70% ethanol on all equipment and outer abdomen to sterilize.
Open the abdomen using scalpel, scissors, and forceps to reveal abdominal cavity.
Refrain from using scissors or forceps to remove or pierce internal organs.
Cut loose connective tissue holding the organs in place if necessary.
Use fingers to move the liver and gizzard to the right side of the abdomen.
Identify the oviduct once it is accessible.
Cut a 10 cm section of the magnum region from the oviduct.
Place the dissected oviduct segment into a 50 mL tube containing 1× PBS/Primocin.
Trim the outside of the oviduct of connective tissue and blood vessels in a 60 mm tissue culture dish.
Cut the oviduct into two pieces, roughly 4–5 cm long.
Cut each oviduct piece lengthwise along the oviduct to open it and expose the lumen lined by tubular glands.
Wash the oviduct pieces 3–5 times in 1× PBS/Primocin until all residual egg white and blood have been removed.
Transfer the washed oviduct pieces to a new 60 mm tissue culture dish.
Mince the oviduct tissue finely (<1 mm in diameter) using scissors, scalpel, or razor blade.
Transfer the minced tissue to a 50 mL tube.
Add 10 mL of 1 mg/mL Collagenase P to the minced tissue.
Incubate at 37°C for 40 min, agitating the solution every 10 min.
Prepare a discontinuous Percoll gradient based on buoyant densities for epithelial cells (1.065–1.07 g/mL) and fibroblasts (1.04–1.055 g/mL).
Pipette the tissue suspension into the prepared Percoll gradient.
Centrifuge at 800 x g for 30 min without brake, ensuring no deceleration during centrifugation.
Remove the supernatant and collect the epithelial cells from the interphase layer between the two Percoll layers.
Prepare the stock isotonic Percoll (SIP) according to Table 1.
Duplicate Percoll dilutions as specified in Table 1.
Layer the highest density Percoll dilution (1.08 g/mL) at the bottom of a 15 mL tube.
Use a 1 mL syringe with a 20G needle to layer each subsequent denser Percoll dilution on top of the previous one.
Keep the needle bevel against the side of the 15 mL tube while adding each dilution slowly.
After 40 minutes, gently pipette the cell suspension up and down several times to break clumps.
Filter the supernatant through a 70 μm nylon cell strainer into a new 50 mL tube.
Transfer the filtered supernatant to a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL DMEM.
Layer the single-cell suspension on top of the Percoll gradient.
Centrifuge the Percoll gradient at 1000 × g for 40 min at room temperature.
Add 1 mL complete culture media to 8 wells of a 12-well plate labeled "fraction 1–8" (in duplicate).
Keep the prepared 12-well plate in a CO2 incubator to pre-warm to 37°C.
Remove and dispose of the first 500 μL from the top of the Percoll gradient.
Use a new p1000 tip for each fraction to remove and plate 1 mL fractions spanning across the density borders.
Pipette from the top of the fraction, moving down as the liquid level drops.
Incubate the 12-well plates at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Check the plates daily until cells have settled.
Replace the media after 2–5 days when the cells have settled.
Pool fractions with no visible fibroblasts after 1 week into a single well using 1× trypsin-EDTA.
Expand pooled cells for future use.
Seed COEC and fibroblasts (control) on separate 12 mm coverslips placed in two wells of a 24-well plate.
Incubate seeded plates at 37°C, 5% CO2 until 60%–70% confluent.
Remove culture media from confluent cells.
Fix cells in 1 mL 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash cells twice with 1× PBS to remove 4% PFA.
Permeabilize cells by washing twice with 1 mL TBST for 5 min each on an orbital shaker (50 rpm).
Block cells by adding 1 mL 3% BSA in TBS and incubate for 1 h at room temperature on an orbital shaker (50 rpm).
Add 200 μL primary antibody (Mouse monoclonal anti-chicken OVA, BioLegend Cat# 520401; RRID: AB_2561635) at 10 μg/mL in TBST/3% BSA and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells 3–5 times in TBST for 5 min on an orbital shaker at 50 rpm to remove excess primary antibody.
Perform all steps in the dark from this point.
Add 200 μL of secondary antibody (Rabbit Anti-Mouse IgG H&L (FITC), Abcam Cat# ab97045; RRID: AB_10687747) at a 1:100 dilution in TBST/3% BSA.
Incubate the mixture for 2 h at room temperature in the dark.
Wash cells 3–5 times in TBST for 5 min on an orbital shaker at 50 rpm to remove excess secondary antibody.
Counter-stain nuclei with DAPI (1 μg/mL) for 5 min at room temperature in the dark.
Wash cells for 5 min in 1× TBS to remove excess DAPI.
Mount coverslips onto a microscope slide with mounting media, such as Fluoromount Aqueous Mounting Medium.
Image cells with a fluorescent imaging microscope.
Prepare a large-scale, endotoxin-free preparation of the recombinant IgG expression plasmid according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Seed COEC at 1 × 10^6 in a T25 flask and incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 until 60-70% confluent, which can take 2-3 days.
Replace the culture media with 4.6 mL of fresh complete culture media on the day of transfection.
For antibody expression with Protein A purification, replace FBS in the COEC culture media with chicken serum or use IgG-depleted FBS.
Dilute 15 μL of 1 mg/mL PEI MAX in 200 μL OptiPRO SFM.
Dilute 5 μg plasmid DNA in 200 μL OptiPRO SFM.
Add the diluted PEI MAX to the diluted DNA, mix by pipetting, and incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Add the transfection mix (400 μL) to the T25 containing 4.6 mL culture media.
Incubate the T25 overnight at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Replace the culture media in the T25 flask.
Incubate the T25 for 5–7 days, replenishing hormones every 2 days.
Centrifuge the collected culture media at 4500 rpm for 20 minutes.
Resuspend Protein A beads and add 2 mL to a 14 cm chromatography column attached to a retort stand.
Allow the Protein A column to settle.
Equilibrate the column with 10 mL of 1× PBS.
Load the supernatant onto the column.
Collect the flow-through for storage on ice.
Pass the supernatant through the column 3–4 times.
Wash the column twice with 10 mL of 1× PBS.
Elute the antibody from the column with 4.5 mL elution buffer into a 15 mL tube containing 500 μL neutralization buffer.
Concentrate the eluted antibody to less than 1 mL using a 10 kDa MWCO Vivaspin 6 concentrator according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Quantify the antibody using spectrophotometry and store the antibody at −20°C for future use.
